title: Karbala yaad rahey karbobala yaad rahey
body:
karbala yaad rahey karbobala yaad rahey
ghar mohammed ke navasey ka luta yaad rahey
1. waqt tha asr ka jab shey ne diya sar apna
haaye woh teg-e-sitam khushk gala yaad
rahey
<<DIVIDER>>
2. kaisi shaadi thi rachi haaye huwi barbadi
aayi ek shab ki dulhan par jo bala yaad rahey
<<DIVIDER>>
3. jab lagi akber-e-mehroo ke jigar par barchi
shay ki binaayi gayi arsh hila yaad rahey
<<DIVIDER>>
4. ta qayamat nahi bichdenge wafa-o-abbas
naam-e-abbas se baqi hain wafa yaad rahey
<<DIVIDER>>
5. sar pe islam ke jab dhoop sitam ki aayi
dedi kulsoom ne zainab ne rida yaad rahey
<<DIVIDER>>
6.tum ko har haal mein karna hain gham-e-sibtey
nabi
shay ne aafat mein hamein kiya yaad rahey
<<DIVIDER>>
7. kehke labbaik utho matam-e-shabbir karo
aaj bhi aati hain halmin ki sada yaad rahey
<<DIVIDER>>
8. teer kab asghar-e-beshir ki gardan pa laga
teer woh qalb-e-mohammed pa laga yaad
rahey
<<DIVIDER>>
9. be sahara huwa islam to shey ne sarwat
dediye baazo-e-abbas zaara yaad rahey
